$Comment: The primary station of the fish-prep multi-station exemplar, jar-layer content carrying zero progression. Deliberately thin - its one action, 'Prep', is attached by Ref to the standalone Server/RpgStations/Actions/PrepFish.json, which owns every mechanical group (Select/Custody/Tool/Work/Anchors/Steps). Own-asset references are authored PascalCase, matching the referenced file's own name; matching stays case-insensitive so a casing slip never breaks content. Worker is the one group this entry authors itself, and it REPLACES the Ref base's Worker wholesale (a Ref overlay is group-wise): PrepFish authors no Worker at all, so this is purely additive in practice. It must carry Puppet, because an action authoring any Walk step requires an enabled Puppet (validator WALK_REQUIRES_PUPPET) - the player stays hidden and held here while the puppet walks to the cooking-fire anchor and back. Hold/Camera ride the same group and use the effect-mode default (the Entity standing-mount route stays unverified elsewhere in this mod, not reused here).
